opening.argument: The material makes a direct daily-profit pitch for a sandwich frontrunning bot, stating “Make $1K / Day | $1000 Daily profits with Mevengine Sandwich Frontrunning bot.” It presents the automated bot as “ready to deploy,” links its secured smart contract to competing for MEV profits, and describes rapid front-running and back-running. The promotion then directs viewers to obtain the product, including the instruction “Download MEV Engine Sandwich MEV Bot Now!” and a download link in the description. These combined claims and calls to action establish a promoted trading-bot return opportunity. The available evidence does not establish actual profits, payment requirements, the QR destination, or any completed transaction.
